scope.all_thirteen_native_routines: All supported, including private helpers and all three explicit/implicit advection flags. No optionals.
scope.jax_scope_only: Same 13 routines. Do not copy JAX guarded denominators/clipped gradients, general sort, nonfatal invalid-state callback, repeated-term algebra or reordered helpers.
scope.external_dependency: calc_roots::cubic_solve(nz,a_coef,b_coef,c_coef,d_coef) -> complex(nz,3), two calls in calc_limits_F_x_responder; current dependency remains explicit until root promotes a port/bridge.
scope.ownership: Column-first LayoutLeft caller fields and call-local scratch; no global storage. Device scalar lower forms for independent cell expressions; profile interfaces retain Native nz and full argument order.
scope.errors: Invalid F_x<=0 with abs(Skx)>0 emits both exact Native lines and fatal stop after vector validity evaluation. Preserve original unsorted first root in one-real-root branches.
scope.bfb: No speculative FMA/reassociation/transcendental changes. Required CPU Native vs CPU Kokkos zero-tolerance model comparisons remain root integration work; GPU milestone results documented separately.
